description: Extract CSV merchandise (or similar) data and aggregate revenue by calendar week, month, or quarter. Stores one small JSON row per period in an Airflow Variable.

source_csv.description: Path to the source CSV relative to the project root
source_csv.title: Source Csv

grain.description: Calendar bucket for aggregation: week (ISO), month, or quarter
grain.title: Grain

date_column.description: Column containing dates to bucket (cast to DATE in SQL)
date_column.title: Date Column

revenue_column.description: Numeric column to sum as revenue
revenue_column.title: Revenue Column

target_variable.description: Airflow Variable name for the JSON aggregate (one row per period)
target_variable.title: Target Variable

title: Extract and aggregate
